name: anschreiben-pilot
what: AI cover-letter generator for the DACH market, forked from vincanger/coverlettergpt (GPL-3.0). Differentiation: correct German (DIN 5008) formatting, deliberately simpler than the 11 competitors found (JobStep, Rezi, MakeMyCV, bewerbung.net, bewerbung2go.de, LiveCareer, Jotform, onlinelebenslauf.com, ki-motivationsschreiben.ch, jobs.ch, Bewerbung.ai), plus a free Bewerbungsmappe PDF-merger as a growth hook. Full research and spec live in brain: brain/projects/micro-saas-dach.md and brain/projects/micro-saas-dach-spec-cover-letter-cv.md.
open: UI translation to German is done across the app (JobsPage, CheckoutPage, CoverLetterPage, Modal/DescriptionModal/CallToAction/CreativitySlider, plus the earlier MainPage/NavBar/LoginPage/ProfilePage/Popover/AlertDialog). TosPage and PrivacyPolicyPage chrome (heading, "last updated") is translated, but their legal body text is real Impressum/AGB/Datenschutz boilerplate, deliberately left in English with a TODO comment — needs an actual lawyer, not a translation pass.
Domain name still not decided — anschreibenpilot.de/.com are free and reserved as the working choice, but Saskia said she wants something more creative; not registered yet
Set up Render deployment (Docker, per Wasp's generated Dockerfile) instead of Fly.io/Railway (not started)
Set up Stripe/Polar for DACH pricing before any real launch (still uses vince's original US Stripe product IDs and USD pricing)
Privacy policy needs real legal review before handling real user data (GDPR) — not drafted

No live Postgres tested yet (needs Docker or a hosted DB + an OpenAI key) — compiled clean and the Lightning-removal migration is verified against Prisma's own diff engine, but the running app itself (wasp start) has not been exercised end to end
DIN 5008 prompt change is unverified against a real OpenAI API call — no key configured in this environment
done: Bewerbungsmappe PDF-merger built (2026-09-23): public /bewerbungsmappe route, no login required, client-side only via pdf-lib (no file upload to the server) — add/reorder/remove PDFs, merge and download as one file. Linked from NavBar for both logged-in and logged-out users. Compiled clean with wasp 0.15.0. Not yet exercised in a running browser session (no live wasp start / Postgres in this environment).
